title: Buyer Cancellation of an Undelivered Deal — Vehicle Purchase Agreements Terms
content:
**Terms of cancellation for buyers under the Vehicle Purchase Agreements.**

**(a) Who may cancel, and when.** A buyer may cancel a deal that has not been delivered. A buyer cancellation is processed only for a deal in reserved or contracted status, as the deal's record shows.

**(b) Signed request.** A cancellation is processed only on the buyer's own signed request recorded for the deal: a reservation cancellation for a reserved deal, a contract cancellation for a contracted deal. It takes effect when the store processes it.

**(c) Amount retained.** For a reserved deal the store retains the deal type's non-refundable portion. For a contracted deal it retains the non-refundable portion plus the contract cancellation fee. The amount retained never exceeds the deposit held, and nothing beyond the deposit held is billed to the buyer.

**(d) Late-delivery waiver.** Where the deal type's late-delivery waiver applies and a contracted deal has not been delivered by the end of the delivery window, the cancellation retains nothing. The window is the deal type's delivery window in calendar days after the contract date, with the contract date as day 0.

**(e) Booking.** The retained amount is booked as forfeitures against the deposits in date order, earliest first. Every remaining deposit amount is refunded, one refund per deposit with that deposit's payment method, within the deal type's refund period in calendar days after the processing date.

**(f) Delivered deals.** A delivered deal cannot be cancelled. Its only return path is the exchange policy.

## Hypothetical cases

| Deal | Deposit held | Non-refundable portion | Cancellation fee | Retained |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| reserved | 1500.00 | 500.00 | not applicable | 500.00 |
| contracted, within window | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 695.00 | 1195.00 |
| contracted, within window | 800.00 | 500.00 | 695.00 | 800.00 (capped at the deposit held) |
| contracted, window passed undelivered, waiver applies | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 695.00 | nothing |
